id: title:Silthus:keep an existing dmarc record when auto configuring email dns

review.posthog_relevance: Adds configuration and safety checks to the Domain Connect email authentication workflow, allowing users to specify target groups and preventing conflicts with existing DMARC records.
review.reason: The change adds a `group_ids` parameter to the domain connection URL and its builder, allowing the connector to apply email authentication templates to specific groups rather than globally. It also adds DNS DMARC record lookup and absence detection, checking for existing DMARC records before applying templates to avoid conflicts. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement:
review.uncertainty: The exact implementation and test coverage are not fully visible, and the benefit of avoiding DMARC conflicts is a potential operational improvement rather than a demonstrated outcome. No tier assignment performed.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.
